name: Classic Spaghetti Carbonara
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook spaghetti according to package directions.
While pasta cooks, fry pancetta in a large pan until crispy.
In a bowl, whisk together eggs, grated cheese, and plenty of black pepper.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water, then drain the spaghetti.
Add hot pasta to the pan with pancetta, remove from heat.
Quickly stir in egg mixture, adding pasta water to create a creamy sauce.
Serve immediately with extra cheese and black pepper.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and half the spice blend for 30 minutes.
Heat oil in a large pan and cook onion until softened.
Add garlic, ginger, and remaining spices. Cook for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
In another pan, cook marinated chicken until browned.
Add chicken to the sauce along with coconut cream.
Simmer for 15 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice or naan.

name: Classic Caesar Salad
instructions: For the dressing: blend anchovies, garlic, egg yolk, lemon juice, and mustard.
Slowly drizzle in olive oil while blending until emulsified.
Season with salt and pepper.
Toss chopped romaine with dressing.
Top with croutons and shaved Parmesan.
Serve immediately.

name: Beef Tacos
ingredients: Sour cream and salsa for serving
instructions: Cook ground beef in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add onion and garlic, cook until softened.
Stir in taco seasoning and 1/4 cup water.
Simmer for 5 minutes until thickened.
Warm taco shells according to package directions.
Fill shells with beef mixture.
Top with lettuce, tomatoes, cheese, sour cream, and salsa.

name: Japanese Miso Soup
ingredients: 1 sheet nori seaweed, cut into strips
instructions: Bring dashi stock to a gentle simmer.
Add wakame and let it rehydrate for 2 minutes.
Add tofu cubes and heat through.
In a small bowl, mix miso paste with a ladle of hot broth.
Turn off heat and stir miso mixture into the soup.
Garnish with green onions and nori strips.
Serve immediately (do not boil after adding miso).
